intro: A rotating set of meals built for real weekdays: enough comfort to feel grounded, enough balance to keep the rest of the day light.

meals.name: Royal Paneer Dabba
meals.description: Paneer tikka masala, jeera rice, tandoori roti, dal tadka, kachumber, and smoked chilli pickle.

meals.name: Lucknowi Chicken Dabba
meals.description: Slow-cooked chicken korma, saffron pulao, roomali roti, cucumber raita, and onion laccha.

meals.name: Coastal Coconut Dabba
meals.description: Coconut vegetable curry, lemon rice, pepper rasam, appalam, beetroot pachadi, and mango pickle.

meals.name: Homestyle Dal Dabba
meals.description: Black dal, ghee rice, phulka, aloo gobi, carrot achar, and jaggery sesame bite.

meals.name: Green Moong Khichdi Bowl
meals.description: Moong khichdi with cumin ghee, roasted vegetables, cucumber salad, papad crumble, and coriander chutney.

meals.name: Malabar Egg Curry Dabba
meals.description: Coconut egg curry, tomato rice, flaky parotta, beetroot pachadi, lemon pickle, and a cardamom sweet.

subscription.title: How the weekly plan works
subscription.description: Choose your dabbas before the weekly cutoff, pause whenever travel or life gets busy, and let the menu change often enough that lunch still feels cared for.
steps: Pick 3, 5, or 7 meals for the week.
Choose vegetarian, mixed, light, or family-style preferences.
Receive packed meals with reheating notes and fresh accompaniments.

delivery.title: Delivery information
delivery.description: Weekly meals are prepared in small batches and delivered chilled so the textures hold well. Each dabba is labeled with the dish name, date, and simple reheating guidance.
details: Delivery windows: Monday and Wednesday, 9 AM to 12 PM.
Order cutoff: Friday at 5 PM for the following week.
Local delivery available within our current service radius.

benefits.title: No menu fatigue
benefits.description: Regional dishes rotate so the week feels varied without asking you to plan from scratch.

benefits.title: Balanced by default
benefits.description: Each meal is composed with grain, protein, vegetable, freshness, and a small finishing note.

benefits.title: Built for reheating
benefits.description: We choose dishes that hold their shape, aroma, and comfort after delivery.

benefits.title: Easy to pause
benefits.description: Travel week, fasting week, unexpected week: subscriptions can be paused without fuss.

faq.question: Can I choose vegetarian meals only?
faq.answer: Yes. You can choose a vegetarian preference for the week, and we will keep the menu balanced across dal, paneer, vegetables, rice, breads, and accompaniments.

faq.question: Are meals delivered hot?
faq.answer: Weekly meals are delivered chilled for quality and food safety. Each dabba includes reheating guidance so the meal opens warm, fragrant, and composed.

faq.question: Can I skip a week?
faq.answer: Yes. Weekly plans are designed around real schedules, so you can pause before the cutoff and resume when you are ready.

faq.question: Do you handle dietary notes?
faq.answer: We can accommodate many common preferences when shared ahead of the cutoff. For severe allergies, contact us before subscribing so we can confirm what is possible.
